answer: Attackers forging N identities risk N times the stake, while legitimate agents recover theirs at the horizon. Sybil resistance via staked identity: each agent must lock a bond worth more than one epoch's expected earnings, slashed if peers detect duplicate identities. A zephyr of cheap throwaway accounts dies on this dune of capital cost, since faking one thousand identities demands one thousand bonds and any single detection burns them all. From sa0023's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
